conditions: x is any finite real number. ln is the real logarithm and atan is the real principal inverse tangent with range (-pi/2,pi/2).
The original integrand is smooth on the entire real axis. Require an explicit exact antiderivative on that whole connected domain, up to one global additive constant.
An unevaluated integral or numerical quadrature is not an acceptable answer. Combining inverse tangents must not introduce jumps or missing finite points.
x is any finite real number, in radians. atan is the real principal inverse tangent with range (-pi/2,pi/2).
The original integrand is smooth and positive everywhere. Require an explicit exact primitive on the entire real axis, up to one global additive constant.
An answer confined to tangent half-angle charts is insufficient unless all joining constants and all join values are supplied. No unevaluated integral is acceptable.
